title: The Summit Where Contradiction Becomes Unity

features.name: the seven versions standing
features.desc-on-touch: Each version of the story holds its ground here, equally true, no longer arguing. You see them all at once and they become a single sentence with seven subjects.

features.name: the silence that unified them
features.desc-on-touch: At the summit, where all the versions met and stopped speaking, a silence formed that is louder than speech. This is what they agreed upon by refusing to choose.

features.name: the view from here
features.desc-on-touch: From this height you can see all seven paddocks where the story was filed. Each one glints differently in the same light. They are one place viewed seven ways.

features.name: the archive's own contradiction
features.desc-on-touch: Here the archive keeps itself, all seven versions filed as one, each title slightly different, each checksum the same. The corruption is complete.

inscription: contradiction at the summit becomes the clarity that reaches into every valley

file.name: The_Story_In_Seven_Versions_Final.txt
file.note: All versions true. All versions silent. Each reader climbs and finds the version they needed to hear.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the summit where stories become one
narr: you climbed and she climbed, taking different paths up the same hill,
and when you reached the top at the same moment, neither was surprised.
the seven versions of the story lay beneath you in seven fields.
she looked at you. you looked out. the silence between you became
the eighth version, the one the paddocks had been waiting for.
the archive recorded it by keeping it unwritten.

exits.label: back down into the paddocks where the story spreads into seven versions
toward the far horizon where more hills wait with their own stories
upward still, where silence learns to speak in the language of stone
